# HealNari — Connected Women's Health & Multi-Disciplinary Telemedicine Platform

> One connected platform for women's health — connecting women with verified specialists across Gynaecology, PCOS & Hormones, Endocrinology, Dermatology, Hair & Scalp, Clinical Nutrition, and Movement Therapy.

## Platform Identity & Core Services
- **Platform Name:** HealNari
- **Category:** Women's Health Telemedicine & Digital Clinic Network (Mobile-First PWA)
- **Primary Website:** https://healnari.vercel.app
- **Provider Portal:** https://healnari.vercel.app/for-doctors
- **Consultation Model:** 45-minute encrypted HIPAA-aligned WebRTC video consultations with board-verified doctors (NMC / GMC / Board Certified).
- **Introductory Consultation Fee:** ₹799 (Includes 45-minute video call, diagnostic lab roadmap, customized diet & lifestyle protocol, digitally signed electronic prescription, and 14 days of free follow-up chat).
- **Target Geographies:** India, UAE/GCC, UK, US, Germany, and globally.

## Specialist Clinical Domains
1. **Women's Health & Gynaecology:** https://healnari.vercel.app/gynecology-womens-health
   - Focus: Irregular cycles, dysmenorrhea (painful periods), heavy bleeding, pelvic pain, PMS/PMDD, vaginal health.
2. **PCOS & Hormonal Health:** https://healnari.vercel.app/pcos-treatment-online
   - Focus: Root-cause diagnosis under 2023 Rotterdam Consensus criteria, insulin resistance, androgen excess, anovulation, holistic reversal.
3. **Endocrinology & Thyroid:** https://healnari.vercel.app/thyroid-consultation
   - Focus: Hypothyroidism, Hashimoto's thyroiditis, subclinical thyroid disorders, adrenal cortisol imbalance.
4. **Dermatology & Skin Care:** https://healnari.vercel.app/hormonal-dermatology-acne
   - Focus: Hormonal & cystic acne, hirsutism, melasma, hyperpigmentation, skin barrier restoration.
5. **Hair & Scalp Health (Trichology):** https://healnari.vercel.app/hair-loss-trichology
   - Focus: Female pattern hair loss (androgenic alopecia), telogen effluvium, ferritin/iron deficiencies, scalp health.
6. **Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics:** https://healnari.vercel.app/clinical-nutrition-dietetics
   - Focus: Evidence-based anti-inflammatory meal planning, gut-hormone axis, culturally adapted nutrition (Indian, Middle Eastern, Western).
7. **Yoga & Movement Support:** https://healnari.vercel.app/yoga-movement-therapy
   - Focus: Cycle-synced somatic movement, pelvic floor conditioning, vagal nerve down-regulation, stress reduction.
8. **Fertility & Preconception Care:** https://healnari.vercel.app/fertility-preconception-care
   - Focus: Ovulation induction mapping, egg quality optimization, preconception biomarker panels.
9. **Hormonal Weight Management:** https://healnari.vercel.app/hormonal-weight-loss
   - Focus: Insulin sensitization, metabolic resistance, sustainable body composition without crash diets.

## Healthcare Provider Network
- Telemedicine Platform for Doctors: https://healnari.vercel.app/for-doctors
- Zero clinic overhead, AI-assisted EMR, pre-screened patient intake, and 90% net payout weekly.
- Compliance: HIPAA, GDPR, DHA (UAE), and 256-bit encrypted telemedicine standards.
